Seldon Desktop thread SLD-2, 2026-11-09 to 2026-11-24, final. No design note was written by this session directly: every ruling it caused was written by its tasks as addenda under docs/design (AD-013 A01, A02; AD-033 A02; AD-034 A09 to A12; AD-036 A12 to A14; AD-037 none yet; AD-038 A12, A13), which is why the handoff is forced.

WHAT IS TRUE NOW (read from the graph and files at 12:55 EST, 2026-11-24)
- The scoped gate (SEL-041: `seldon gate plan|run`, `dispatch.gate.slices`, gate_run records, gate_timeout_s 7200) is NOT on seldon's main. It is finished on a branch. Two landings failed: SEL-041's own merge (stopped by this thread on the operator's "hold", 2026-11-21) and SEL-045 (regate_red: killed at main's 3,600 s gate timeout at 81 percent).
- SEL-045R (8315cc7a) is registered and will launch on the next pass. It merges kept branch worktree-modular-knitting-hinton, carries its checks in the form the parser reads, and takes test_pa002 out of gate_command by name (Issue d6040ce8). SEL-045 (09520bb0) is superseded by it. First OODA: read its RESULT and the merge record; confirm `checks_run` is above zero and `gate_evidence.source` is the Stop gate. If it is blocked again, do not file a fourth landing before reading why.
- SEL-042 IS on main (2026-11-21): a hard-stopped session never merges; a merge needs gate evidence; with none the round runs gate_command itself. That last rule is what makes consumers gate twice.
- Held on the operator's word, 2026-11-21, NOT lifted in this thread: SEL-043 (bf0b7a06, cross-project lease, gate progress, wall time) and SEL-044 (46540234, portfolio brief). hazbrief measured a 100-minute wait on seldon's lease on 2026-11-24; SEL-043 is the task for it. Ask the operator once, plainly, whether the hold is off.
- hazbrief: HB-217 and HB-218 blocked by its own thread; HB-218 (declare slices) can be released only after SEL-045R merges. Tell the operator when it does; he relays.

OPEN FILINGS, UNANSWERED
- 1e367024 (hazbrief, 2026-11-24): bare check lines are not read; `seldon cc complete` completed a round-blocked task with no gate evidence (HB-221) and its successor was released; the 100-minute lease wait; a governing-note hold that told nobody.
- 706c40a2 (factory, 2026-11-24): a hold that waits on a person tells nobody (FAC-06 sat merge_blocked ten days).
- 6087e4d1 (factory portfolio entry point), 44ba49df, 083863ef, 9fb2e0b8 (squiddy): answered by held SEL-043 and SEL-044.
- 71438cd8 in factory (from seldon): gate time per project is unwatched. 45b88039 and 750348cb in squiddy (from seldon): a cited-sources graph was built by hand twice; the operator's coarse tier for reference documents. No answers seen.

ANSWERS ALREADY KNOWN, VERIFIED IN CODE (seldon/core/criteria.py)
- A check is read only as a list item under an `Acceptance:` label (or an Acceptance heading). Every list item under that label, up to the next heading, is taken as a criterion, so the Acceptance list goes LAST in a Part with nothing but `check:` or `judgment:` items in it. Form: "- `check: <command>` passes." A bare `check:` line under a Part heading is read by nobody and refused by nobody. SEL-042's RESULT and HB-217 told hazbrief the bare form; that was wrong and five hazbrief tasks were written on it.
- `stations.check_timeout_s` is 1,800 s per check; `stop_gate_timeout_s` 3,600 s.

WHAT THIS THREAD GOT WRONG (so the next one does not repeat it)
1. Rules written without measuring their cost: SEL-042's evidence rule doubled hazbrief's 65-to-90-minute gate on the day SEL-041 was registered because that gate was too long.
2. Claims passed on unverified: "nothing changes for hazbrief today" (false: hazbrief's dispatcher runs seldon's main); "give each Part a check line" (false form); SEL-045 closing a filing as landed before its merge (the task file ordered it).
3. Notices filed as dispatchable tasks in a consumer's queue (HB-217, HB-218) on its submission day. A return that asks nothing must not run a gate. SEL-045 and SEL-045R file none.
4. Scope wider than asked: SEL-036 resolved all 72 citations and parsed whole documents (87 and 97 minute builds) when the need was proof a cited passage was seen.
5. A red suite waved through: test_pa002 failed on main in nine consecutive task RESULTs and nobody filed it until today (d6040ce8).
6. Sequencing by wait_on made SEL-045 start the moment hazbrief's queue emptied and hold the lease while hazbrief's next task was ready.

- seldon-biblio: 148 entries, 84 with text, served in the primary; frozen pending squiddy's answer; 5 PDFs sit in graphs/seldon-biblio/intake/inbox; 12 sources still manual; NIST SP 800-53 parse crashed and is not wanted.

- Issues 83b09573, 1cc32488 fixed by SEL-035; aa93bfb4 (SEL-041 merge_blocked) and 1722aa25 (SEL-045 merge_blocked) close when SEL-045R merges.
- A discarded (superseded) task whose kept branch later merges brings its discarded event lines back: SEL-045 patched one case with a compensating event and said the machine has no rule. SEL-045R merges a second superseded task's branch and will meet it again.
- In seldon's primary, untracked and ignored: .seldon/quarantine_uv.lock_2026-11-21 and .venv/ (made by an OODA session's `uv run`; fixed in SEL-042). Kept worktrees: splendid-seeking-russell, modular-knitting-hinton.
